(Currently Amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer positioned adjacent to a first layer and a second adhesive layer positioned adjacent to a second layer, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are aligned with each other; and an additional adhesive layer coupled to at least one of the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer.

(Currently Amended) Claim 282: The tool of claim 281, wherein the additional adhesive layer is positioned on the medial section.

(Currently Amended) Claim 283: The tool of claim 282, wherein the medial section comprises a metal layer.

(Currently Amended) Claim 284: The tool of claim 283, wherein the metal layer is a honeycomb structure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 285: The tool of claim 281, wherein a weld ring is at least partially interposed between a perimeter of the first and second layers and a plurality of cutting segments.

(Currently Amended) Claim 286: The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

(Currently Amended) Claim 287: The tool of claim 286, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

(Currently Amended) Claim 288: The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is continuous.

(Currently Amended) Claim 290: The tool of claim 285, further including an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

(Currently Amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 290, wherein the inner ring includes a central opening.

(Currently Amended) Claim 293: The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments.

(Currently Amended) Claim 294: The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is continuous.
